abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Refibrillator
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 46.0/48.4/50.9/53.5/56.3/59.2/62.2/65.3/68.6/72.0/75.5/79.2/83.0/86.9/90.9/95.1/99.4/103.8 (+55% physical power) physical damage. Enemies hit are afflicted with a stacking DoT that deals 12.0/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2/21.0/22.8/24.6/26.4/28.2/30.0/31.8/33.6/35.4/37.2/39.0/40.8/42.6 (+12% magical power) (+0.6 per Level) magical damage on-hit over 3s.

abilities.name: Triage Protocol
abilities.description: Zinx gains a stack for 5s when damaging Enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks or Abilities, up to a maximum of 5. At maximum stacks, Triage Protocol activates, removing any active combat penalty from Zinx, granting her 25% decaying Movement Speed, and +75% increased Infuse Healing for 5s. Stacks cannot be gained while Triage Protocol is on cooldown.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.description: Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65.0/90.0/115.0/140.0/165.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Stunning for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s. The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration. Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.

abilities.name: Bad Medicine
abilities.description: Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals 45.0/65.0/85.0/105.0/125.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Slows by 35% for 0.75s. After 0.75s, the radiation erupts dealing 55.0/85.0/115.0/145.0/175.0 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 35% for 0.75s.

abilities.name: Infuse
abilities.description: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally that restores 60.0/95.0/130.0/165.0/200.0 (+50% magical power) Health, increasing by up to 40% based on their missing health.

abilities.name: Neural Regenesis
abilities.description: Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally Hero, granting 45% decaying Movement Speed and Revival for 4s. If the Target takes lethal damage within this time, they Resurrect with 500.0/900.0/1300.0 (+235% magical power) Health and 250.0/400.0/550.0 (+110% magical power) Mana after 2.5s.

augments.name: Heal Matrix
augments.description: Infuse now has 2 charges but heals 15% less.

augments.name: Terminal Treatment
augments.description: Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-35%, based on Target's Missing Health.

augments.name: Disc Of Demise
augments.description: Ricochet bounces 25% further and each hit reduces its Current Cooldown by 5%, increased to 10% for Heroes.
